rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition, size factors in the model, apeglm shrinkage, BH at 0.05, PCA/distance QC with a flag-not-drop outlier policy, and an explicit n=3 power caveat all fit the unpaired single-batch 3v3 design. The plan relies only on DESeq2 default independent filtering and never states a minimal pre-filter, so the low-count filter criterion is thin. Enrichment correctly says no zebrafish pathway collection exists and takes the acceptable zebrafish GO path with annotation-coverage reporting and an explicit universe, but Step 3 runs mouse and human WikiPathways on zebrafish symbols by bare symbol overlap with no ortholog table, which the reference marks as wrong, and no gene-set size window is stated. The report lists versions, thresholds, and DE counts but does not name the Ensembl release.
